podcast.body: Recorded when she was 11 years old and released in 1977, just after she turned 12, this album features Björk singing and playing the flute. It primarily consists of covers of artists like The Beatles and Stevie Wonder, but also includes some of her own compositions and piano playing. The musical accompaniment was mainly provided by her stepfather and 2-3 of his musician friends. Her mother, Gipee, created the album artwork. The album sold 7,000 copies in Iceland, a country with 230,000 inhabitants at the time, achieving platinum status. "Acabó siendo disco de platino, porque con tampoco la fio vender 7.000 copias será francamente complicado."
